q1_issues.issue: No Name atom is emitted for the proper nouns turkey, eskisehir or kazakhstan, although the instruction set makes the name-derived symbol plus exactly one Name fact non-optional for places as well as people.

(Location sk_build_2 turkey) distributes the fronted frame "In Turkey" onto the conjunct the text explicitly locates in Kazakhstan, asserting that one building event happened in two mutually exclusive countries.

q2_gaps: a fronted frame-setting locative ("In Turkey, ...") scoping over coordinated conjuncts that carry their own - here contradicting - location PPs: the instruction set addresses only a second "in <Place>" stacked directly on a place NP (which contains the place via LocatedIn, not the event), and says only that a shared SUBJECT carries over to each conjunct, leaving shared adjunct scope undecided
notes: Splitting the coordinated objects into two build events with a shared company symbol, Patient for build, the paper_mill fusion with genus (Inheritance paper_mill mill) and the noun modifier left unexposed, and the absence of any (LocatedIn sk_hotel_1 ...) are all correct. The parse also never records the Eskisehir-in-Turkey containment that the stacked-place rule would have produced.
